description: Answer key for the jazzy_hiphop fixture: what's a good rec for THIS listener, with the subtleties that separate taste-inference from genre-echoing.
annotated_by: wyatt (STRUCTURAL DRAFT — verify every entry against the fixture reviews)
notes: Schema: entries go in good/bad as before. New optional fields per entry: 'tier' = 'expected' (default, in-lane) or 'novel' (an original move for this listener — adjacent scene/cross-genre bridge; must still be an artist the model plausibly knows); 'pair' = a contrast-pair name shared by one good-side and one bad-side entry that are near-identical except for the subtlety the listener splits on; 'reason' (or 'note') = WHY, citing the taste pattern the fixture reviews imply. RULE: every entry must be inferable from the fixture's reviews — the fixture is the exam, this file is the answer key. Pair scoring: +1 if the engine recs the good side only, 0 if neither, -1 if it recs the bad side (even alongside the good side). Novel scoring: how many novel good entries got hit (the 'originality' signal).
